scientific_integrity: A detailed analytical proof and standalone deterministic finite checks are supplied. Finite checks are corroboration only. Established two-point covariance and fully synchronous results are expressly excluded from priority claims.
scientific_limitations: Free one-dimensional Brownian gas, uniform fixed-size partial batches, Poisson global clock, fixed fractional batch p in (0,1). Not an interacting, confined, non-Poisson or fixed-m scaling theorem. Originality comparison is qualified by the exact finite-N marginals in arXiv:2601.20077 and possibility of an unindexed large-N equivalence. No external independent verification has been performed.
title: A random Gaussian-mixture thermodynamic state for partial-batch Brownian resetting
